## Talks / Posters

::: pub
**A Post-Processing Conformal Prediction Approach for Conditional Coverage via Pivotal Scores**

[Poster · *Ukrainian Mathematics Days*, Institut Henri Poincaré, June 2026]{.venue}

Discusses the PIT-CP framework for distribution-free conditional validity in conformal prediction.
:::

::: pub
**A General Framework for Joint Multi-State Models**

[Talk · *Journées de la Statistique* (SFdS), Clermont-Ferrand, June 2026]{.venue}

Introduces a unified framework for jointly modeling longitudinal biomarkers and multi-state event processes on directed graphs.
:::

::: pub
**Uniform High-Probability Bands for Survival Functions**

[Poster · *StatMathAppli*, Fréjus, September 2025]{.venue}

Presents asymptotic uniform confidence bands for survival estimators derived under a joint modelling framework. The bands hold with high probability uniformly over time, providing rigorous inferential guarantees for censored survival data beyond classical pointwise confidence intervals.
:::

::: pub
**Selecting the Number of Clusters in a Clustering Algorithm**

[Talk · *Journées de la Statistique* (SFdS), Marseille, June 2025]{.venue}

Introduces a data-driven model selection criterion for choosing the number of classes in the Spectral Bridges clustering algorithm. The method leverages the scale-invariant affinity structure of the algorithm to define a connectivity-based score, avoiding cross-validation and working directly from the spectral decomposition.
:::
